Jordan Lee: hi all — Jordan here, day 2 on infra. trying to run a tiny smoke test in us-west2 but hitting permissions both in GCP and AWS. who's the right contact for billing/account link + regional roles? :wave:

Jordan Lee: GCP error: ```ERROR: Permission denied while listing instances on project redwood-us-sandbox (no compute.viewer).```

Jordan Lee: AWS console shows: "No billing account linked" when opening Billing -> Bills.

mira_it: welcome Jordan! :tada: sounds like SSO group + billing link. For GCP you need `roles/compute.viewer` and `roles/billing.user` on the project/billing account respectively (or be in billing-viewers group). For AWS billing you need the Billing console view role mapped by SSO.

owen_cloudeng: hey — for quick unblock i can add a temporary `compute.viewer` on the project and request the billing link. Also double-check if the project has the billing account attached: `gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-us-sandbox`.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-412 created by mira_it for user Jordan Lee — "Add infra-us SSO + attach billing account". Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-412

mira_it: adding note for ops: if the user needs cross-account AWS access we sometimes require the org role `InvoiceReadOnly`. i'll file that with the ticket.

owen_cloudeng: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on redwood-us-sandbox to jordan.lee@redwood.com for 2 hours. try listing again.

Jordan Lee: can list now, thanks! still can't see AWS billing but ticket is tracking it. one small suggestion — onboarding checklist could include `gcloud beta billing projects describe` as a quick debug step.

mira_it: great feedback, adding that. welcome aboard Jordan! :raised_hands:
